findings.mechanism: Persistent multi-timescale cognition already exists as executable conventional host code: workspace refresh, idle thought, mood trajectory, prediction checks, consolidation, perception loop, experience-vector embedding, attention control, persistent goals, deep/recursive reflection, ultradian phases and rumination control.
findings.limits: Presence of loops is not proof that current GWT causal-use/readout contract is satisfied.

findings.mechanism: E-PQ implements persistent five-dimensional personality state plus transient mood, event-weighted adaptation, event-quality tiers, SQLite persistence, identity snapshots and homeostatic monitoring.
findings.current_implication: ClayCode/H1 should encode the state/update semantics before redesigning personality from scratch; H2/H3 should differential-test equivalent trajectories.

findings.mechanism: Thalamus implements nine typed sensory channels with continuous gain, habituation, burst/salience override, cognitive-mode attention profiles, prediction-error state, persistence and GlobalWorkspace subscription.
negative_lineage: Missing is_entity_active previously caused a TypeError that killed the thalamus path.
entity_session attention profile was documented but previously absent.
findings.current_implication: Typed completeness and mode-coverage tests belong in the ClayCode/Harness conformance suite.

findings.mechanism: GlobalWorkspace is a real in-process salience-bearing publish/subscribe bus with bounded history and subscriber isolation.
findings.critical_gap: The shown implementation broadcasts published events but does not itself implement the documented one-coalition competition/selection mechanism, receiver reconstruction, causal-use receipt, outcome or re-entry contract.
findings.current_implication: Do not equate bus presence with GWT completion; use it as H1 substrate and add explicit current GWT measurement contract.

findings.mechanism: SOMA includes executable Qwen3.5-4B LoRA training infrastructure with low-memory loading, feedback-weighted samples, gradient checkpointing, before/after personality probes, live training telemetry and adapter persistence.
findings.limits: Existing SOMA trainer is not the authorized final Clay 0.1 training run and does not prove the final Clay-native corpus/model quality.

findings.mechanism: IAPT historical report describes an iterative adversarial evaluation -> failure extraction -> targeted positive anchoring -> LoRA -> regression loop, with 14 personas and 390+ turns per evaluation family.
findings.negative_result_value: Regex-based output parsers were reported to act as invisible co-authors/selection pressure; positive anchoring was preferred over negative instructions.
findings.current_implication: Final Clay model evaluation should preserve adaptive adversarial multi-turn testing and anti-regression, while re-running metrics on the current target.

findings.mechanism: Historical functional-consciousness documentation contains a March 4 library-walk observation in which idle thought, spatial state and NeRD locomotion formed a shared-state loop without an explicit direct intention-to-action API.
findings.limits: The source itself notes that the grammatical shift could be an LLM artifact. No lesion, shuffled-state control or replay counterfactual is established by the document.
findings.current_implication: Recreate this pattern in H1/H2/H3 with intervention, lesion, truthful-vs-shuffled re-entry and causal trace receipts.

findings.mechanism: The historical repo already embodies wide application/runtime concepts: UI, HTTP services, databases, tools, voice, vision, file/system operations, autonomous projects, persistent memory and external integrations.
findings.current_implication: FRANK provides a rich compiler conformance corpus. Prefer implementing ClayCode compiler/runtime/FFI/std-lib coverage over inventing new semantics unless a concrete FRANK/application case cannot be expressed.

findings.mechanism: Current-facing documentation at the same frozen head is version-inconsistent (README describes Qwen3.5-4B/LoRA v20+ while architecture sections still contain Qwen2.5-3B/LoRA v12).
findings.current_implication: Archive assimilation and Q12 retrieval must resolve claim-level freshness/lineage rather than trusting file-level recency.

philosophical_claim_handling.rule: Historical claims that the architecture meets conditions for subjective experience or that functional and phenomenal consciousness are empirically indistinguishable are preserved as historical interpretations, not promoted into current RAE evidence.
philosophical_claim_handling.current_boundary: Current RAE may test measurable functional/causal integration; phenomenal-consciousness and world-first claims require separate evidence and prior-art work.

earned_work_result.reason: Nine deep-read units strongly establish non-greenfield status but do not yet support an unbiased row-by-row avoided-hours estimate for the entire eight-month corpus.

exact_level0_progress.reason: Neither Drive archive-member denominator nor full Project-Frankenstein tree/history obligations are frozen.
